deepseek_import.intro_desc: Select a ZIP file exported from DeepSeek to import conversations, thinking traces, web search records, and chat images into an existing or new companion in the current vault.
deepseek_import.guide_title: How to get a DeepSeek export ZIP
deepseek_import.guide_step_1: 1. Open DeepSeek web or app and go to Settings → Data Management
deepseek_import.guide_step_2: 2. Tap Export Data and download the generated ZIP archive to this device
deepseek_import.guide_step_3: 3. Tap the button below to pick the ZIP file, preview chats, and import
deepseek_import.dedup_hint: Chats already imported into the same companion are automatically skipped without overwriting existing records.
deepseek_import.existing_empty: No companions available in the current vault yet. Switch to New Companion.
deepseek_import.importing_hint: Please keep the app open. Your existing data will not be modified.
deepseek_import.result_target_new: Created companion "{{name}}" and imported chat history
deepseek_import.error_service_unavailable: Data service is not ready yet. Please try again later.
deepseek_import.error_name_required: Please enter a name for the new companion.
deepseek_import.error_select_session: Please select at least one chat.
